26e75b6dc3f5: Each sentence contains one mistake. Write the whole sentence correctly.
6fe1a761cacb: Szukać requires the genitive (dopełniacz), not the accusative: szukam mieszkania. English “look for” has no case, so the ending must be memorised.
8c4829e9b9c3: Potrzebować takes the genitive (dopełniacz): potrzebuję dokumentów. English “need” takes a plain object, so the case ending is easy to forget.
35abee684c14: “Near the park” = obok / koło + dopełniacz (genitive); przy means “right next to / against something”.
